title: Tiny Routines
subtitle: Why Little Habits Help Anxious Brains
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Do you ever feel like your brain is a tangled ball of yarn?

Cats know instinctively that tiny routines help brains feel safe.

Every morning, I nap on the same spot on the sofa.
After breakfast, I clean my paws and then rest.
Around 3 p.m., I mysteriously relocate to the sunny chair.

When everything else feels uncertain,
tiny habits can act like soft anchors.
You don’t need to build a massive routine.
Start with something small:

  • A glass of water after you brush your teeth.
  • Stretching for 10 seconds after breakfast.
  • Sitting in your favorite spot in the evening.

These tiny routines add up to something big: a calmer, steadier you.
